issues.what: The CRC 'finite-sample certificate' is stated without its monotonicity condition: Conformal Risk Control (Angelopoulos et al. 2022) requires the loss to be monotone in lambda; the risk used here (mean clipped loss of the kept units per session) is not monotone in coverage, so 'the largest lambda with certificate <= alpha' is not a valid CRC selection without monotonising the risk curve, and the certificate can be exceeded at intermediate lambdas.

The design panel prescribed the same rule, and the study's own conclusion (the certificate does not transfer) is only strengthened by this, so the verdict is unchanged.
issues.fix: Footnote the monotonicity requirement next to the exchangeability caveat, or monotonise the certificate curve (running max over lambda) before picking lambda*.
